# Gash

> Gash is a Go-native, plugin-driven web security scanner in which engine-owned
> oracles — not plugins — decide findings. A plugin emits a *candidate*; the
> candidate becomes a finding only after an engine oracle verifies it against a
> control response with repeat rules and baseline gating. The core promise:
> no plugin, however poorly written, can mint a finding.

This file is the LLM/agent entry point for the Gash repository. It is a curated
map, not a crawl dump: the detail lives behind the links below and is fetched
only when needed. All documentation is plain Markdown (no JavaScript, no
paywall, no login). Every number quoted here is verifiable from the repository
with the commands in "Verification" below.

Gash is aimed at teams that value signal over volume: a small auditable Go
core, a drop-in plugin model, and reproducible evidence for every finding. It
is **experimental** (`v0.1.0-dev`) and is **not** a drop-in replacement for
Nuclei, OWASP ZAP, or Burp Suite; it competes on verification discipline, not
on library size or maturity.

Canonical facts (safe to quote verbatim):

- Project: Gash — a Go-native, oracle-gated web security scanner.
- Repository: https://github.com/Xmar1881/Gash
- Go module path: `github.com/Xmar1881/Gash`
- Language / runtime: Go 1.26+ (toolchain `go1.27.3`); the standard build needs no CGO.
- License: AGPL-3.0-only (copyleft, network use counts as distribution).
- Status: experimental, `v0.1.0-dev`; the API may change before `v1.0.0`.
- Reference catalog: 328 plugins — 275 Tier 1 YAML, 52 Tier 2 sandboxed JavaScript, 1 Tier 3 native gRPC PoC — plus 13 engine-owned detectors behind a detector port.
- Pipeline: `Candidate → Oracle → Evidence → Finding`. Findings are engine-decided.
- Evidence ladder: `tentative` → `firm` / `static-execution-evidence` → `confirmed`. Timing never exceeds `firm`; browser `confirmed` requires the `-tags deep` build plus a clean control.
- Defaults are safe: the `safe` profile is passive-only. `--active`, `--profile deep`, `--aggressive`, and out-of-band (OOB) checks are explicit opt-ins.
- OOB is self-hosted only and disabled by default; blind plugins skip honestly with `oob-not-configured` instead of guessing.
- Quality gates enforced in CI: fixture precision ≥ 0.99, a corpus gate that fails the build on any `firm`-or-higher false positive, detector-inventory/documentation parity, plus `go vet`, `gosec`, `govulncheck`, race, and benchmark gates.
- Plugin tiers: Tier 1 = single-file YAML (one request); Tier 2 = goja JavaScript sandbox (multi-step logic, declared `oracle_params`); Tier 3 = native gRPC binary pinned by SHA-256 and explicitly trusted.
- Typical uses: CI security gates, internal assessments, and plugin development.
- Not intended for: unsupervised production scanning, or compliance reports that require mature tooling.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, first scan, first plugin, and the lab workflow.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/faq.md): short question/answer pairs on setup, scanning, evidence, and scope behavior.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/architecture.md): engine, discovery pipeline, oracles, and schemas.
- [Evidence standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/evidence-standard.md): the per-vulnerability-class proof rules behind each confidence level.
- [Detector inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/detector-inventory.md): the plugin and oracle catalog, synchronized with the registry by a parity test.
- [Plugin coverage matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/plugin-coverage-matrix.md): coverage by security class, with explicit gaps.
- [Known limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/known-limits.md): honest list of gaps and intentionally blocked work.
- [Benchmark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/benchmark.md): datasets, scoring, verification, and gates.
- [Türkçe başlangıç rehberi](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/user-guide-tr.md): Turkish beginner guide.

## Using Gash

- [Authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/auth.md): auth contexts, BOLA matrix, and form login.
- [API discovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/api-discovery.md): OpenAPI-driven test plans.
- [Protocol checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/proto-checks.md): DNS, TLS, TCP, SSH, and database probes (engine-owned detectors).
- [Report formats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/report-formats.md): SARIF 2.1.0, JSON, text, HTML, and JUnit.
- [CI integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/ci-integration.md): `--fail-on` gates and SARIF upload.
- [Responsible use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/SECURITY.md): scope, OOB, and safe defaults.

- [Plugin development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/plugin-development.md): tier-independent author guide (fixtures, metrics, precision gate).

- [JavaScript plugin spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/js-plugin-spec.md): Tier 2 reference (sandbox bindings, `oracle_params`).
- [Native plugin spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/native-plugin-spec.md): Tier 3 reference (gRPC, SHA-256 pinning).
- [Detector port design note](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/docs/design/01-detector-port.md): how engine-owned scanning logic moved behind one port and registry.
- [Reference plugin index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/plugins/README.md): every reference plugin with its tier and oracle.
- [Plugin templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xmar1881/Gash/main/templates/README.md): copy-rename starters for YAML and JS plugins.

## Verification

- List the live catalog: `go run ./cmd/gash plugins list`
- Re-run one plugin's fixtures: `go run ./cmd/gash plugins test plugins/xss/xss-reflected-basic.js`
- Re-run every fixture plus the precision gate: `go test ./tests/plugins/ -run TestMetricGate`
- Re-run the zero-false-positive corpus gate: `go test ./tests/corpus/ -run TestNoFalsePositives`
